title: Express a harness change as a testable hypothesis
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth writes the failure mode and expected metric before shipping a harness tweak, then evaluates with and without the change. Accepts inspiration requirement 14[^insp-r14].
implementation: `HarnessExperiment` carries hypothesis, intervention, failure_mode, evidence, and `to_trace_fields` for version/assignment on traces.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
